data.one_liner: Core dependency for Syncfusion Flutter widgets, providing shared functionality.
data.what_it_does: It supplies shared utilities, theme data, and base classes used by all Syncfusion Flutter widgets. It is required for any Syncfusion widget to function.
use_when: Using any Syncfusion Flutter widget such as charts, grids, or maps
Building an app that relies on Syncfusion’s shared core features
avoid_when: You are not using any Syncfusion widgets
You prefer an open‑source alternative that does not require a commercial license
strengths: Stable, actively maintained, always compatible with the latest Syncfusion widgets
Provides essential shared functionality and theme support
No build_runner or code generation required
weaknesses: Requires a Syncfusion commercial or community license
Not a standalone feature set – only a dependency for other packages
data.setup_notes: Add to pubspec.yaml; no additional steps needed.
